var $ = function (s) { return document.querySelector(s); };
function el(tag, cls, html) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (html != null) n.innerHTML = html; return n; }
function fmt(t) { var m = Math.floor(t / 60000), s = Math.floor(t % 60000 / 1000), x = Math.floor(t % 1000);
  return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + String(x).padStart(3, '0'); }
function toast(msg) { var t = el('div', 'toast-item', msg); $('#toast').appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(function () { t.style.opacity = '0'; t.style.transition = 'opacity .3s'; setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 320); }, 2400); }
function download(name, text) { var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: 'application/json' })); a.download = name; a.click();
  setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 500); }
function participant(id) { return LOG.initialState.participants.find(function (p) { return p.id === id; }); }
function pname(id) { var p = participant(id); return p ? p.name : id; }
/* ════ 索引构建 ════ */
function buildIndices() {
  EVS = LOG.events.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; });
  BYID = {}; CHILDREN = {};
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { BYID[e.id] = e; });
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { if (e.parentId) (CHILDREN[e.parentId] = CHILDREN[e.parentId] || []).push(e); });
  var rng = 0, sim = {};
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p) { sim[p.id] = { hp: p.hp, en: p.energy }; });
  EVS.forEach(function (e) {
    if (e.payload && e.payload.rolls) e.payload.rolls.forEach(function (r) { r.idx = ++rng; });
    var deltas = [];
    function cap(list) {
      list.forEach(function (pp) {
        var s = sim[pp.id]; if (!s) return;
        var f = [];
        if (pp.hp != null) { f.push({ k: 'HP', before: s.hp, after: pp.hp }); s.hp = pp.hp; }
        if (pp.energy != null) { f.push({ k: 'EN', before: s.en, after: pp.energy }); s.en = pp.energy; }
        if (f.length) deltas.push({ id: pp.id, fields: f });
      });
    }
    if (e.payload && e.payload.anchor) cap(e.payload.anchor.participants);
    if (e.snapshot) cap(e.snapshot.participants);
    if (deltas.length) e._delta = deltas;
  });
  P.dur = EVS[EVS.length - 1].timestamp + 500;
}
/* ════ 调试树派生（统一事件流 → v2 风格节点） ════ */
function deriveDebugTree() {
  DEBUG_NODES = [];
  var initNode = { kind:'node', id:'n_init', name:'战斗初始化', icon:'◉', events:[] };
  var endNode = { kind:'node', id:'n_end', name:'战斗结束', icon:'◉', events:[] };
  var rounds = [];
  var phaseNodes = {}, actionNodes = {}, roundOf = {};
  var curRound = null;
  function rootOf(ev) { var c = ev; while (c.parentId && BYID[c.parentId]) c = BYID[c.parentId]; return c; }
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) {
    if (ev.phase === 'battle_lifecycle') {
      if (ev.payload.action === 'battle_start') initNode.events.push(ev); else endNode.events.push(ev);
      return;
    }
    if (ev.phase === 'config_load') { initNode.events.push(ev); return; }
    if (ev.phase === 'turn_flow') {
      if (ev.payload.action === 'start') {
        curRound = { kind:'round', id:'n_r' + ev.payload.turn, name:'第 ' + ev.payload.turn + ' 回合', nodes:[] };
        rounds.push(curRound); roundOf[ev.id] = curRound;
      }
      var pn = { kind:'node', id:'n_' + ev.id, name: ev.payload.action === 'start' ? '回合开始 · 结算' : '回合结束 · 结算',
                 icon: ev.payload.action === 'start' ? '▼' : '▲', events:[ev], phase:true };
      phaseNodes[ev.id] = pn;
      if (curRound) curRound.nodes.push(pn);
      return;
    }
    var root = rootOf(ev);
    if (root.phase === 'action_execution') {
      var an = actionNodes[root.id];
      if (!an) {
        an = { kind:'node', id:'n_' + root.id, name: pname(root.sourceId), action:true,
               icon: root.sourceId === 'u1' ? '⚔' : '☠',
               meta: (root.payload.skill || '') + ' · ' + (root.payload.controlMode === 'ai' ? 'AI' : '玩家'),
               actor: root.sourceId, target: root.targetId, hits: root.payload.hits || 1, events:[] };
        actionNodes[root.id] = an;
        if (curRound) curRound.nodes.push(an);
      }
      an.events.push(ev);
    } else if (root.phase === 'turn_flow') {
      var pn2 = phaseNodes[root.id];
      if (pn2) pn2.events.push(ev);
    }
  });
  if (initNode.events.length) DEBUG_NODES.push(initNode);
  rounds.forEach(function (r) { DEBUG_NODES.push(r); });
  if (endNode.events.length) DEBUG_NODES.push(endNode);
}
function allNodesFlat() {
  var out = [];
  DEBUG_NODES.forEach(function (e) { if (e.kind === 'round') e.nodes.forEach(function (n) { out.push(n); }); else out.push(e); });
  return out;
}
function nodeOfEvent(id) {
  return allNodesFlat().find(function (n) { return n.events.some(function (e) { return e.id === id; }); }) || null;
}
/* ════ 舞台与播放（回放投影） ════ */
function buildStage() {
  var arena = $('#arena');
  arena.querySelectorAll('.unit').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); });
  var mid = arena.querySelector('.arena-mid');
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p, i) {
    var u = el('div', 'unit');
    u.id = 'unit-' + p.id;
    u.innerHTML = '<div class="u-top"><span class="u-name">' + p.name + '</span><span class="u-id">' + p.id + '</span><span class="u-dead">DEFEAT</span></div>' +
      '<div class="bar hp"><i></i><span></span></div><div class="bar en"><i></i></div>' +
      '<div class="u-en">EN ' + p.energy + ' / ' + p.maxEnergy + '</div><div class="u-buffs"></div><div class="floats"></div>';
    if (i === 0) arena.insertBefore(u, mid); else arena.appendChild(u);
  });
}
function applyListToSim(sim, list) {
  list.forEach(function (pp) {
    var s = sim[pp.id]; if (!s) return;
    if (pp.hp != null) s.hp = pp.hp;
    if (pp.energy != null) s.en = pp.energy;
    if (pp.buffs) s.buffs = pp.buffs.map(function (b) { return { name: b.name, stacks: b.stacks, turns: b.turns }; });
  });
}
function applyEventToSim(sim, ev) {
  if (ev.payload && ev.payload.anchor) applyListToSim(sim, ev.payload.anchor.participants);
  if (ev.snapshot) applyListToSim(sim, ev.snapshot.participants);
  if (ev.phase === 'buff_lifecycle' && ev.payload) {
    var p = ev.payload, s = sim[ev.targetId];
    if (s) {
      if (p.action === 'update' && p.buff) { var b = s.buffs.find(function (x) { return x.name === p.buff; }); if (b) { b.stacks = p.stacks; b.turns = p.turns; } }
      if (p.action === 'apply' && !p.resisted && !s.buffs.find(function (x) { return x.name === p.buff; })) s.buffs.push({ name: p.buff, stacks: 1, turns: p.turns || 2 });
    }
  }
}
function freshSim() {
  var sim = {};
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p) {
    sim[p.id] = { hp: p.hp, en: p.energy, buffs: (p.buffs || []).map(function (b) { return { name: b.name, stacks: b.stacks, turns: b.turns }; }) };
  });
  return sim;
}
function paintState() {
  var turn = 0;
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) { if (ev.timestamp <= P.t && ev.phase === 'turn_flow' && ev.payload && ev.payload.action === 'start') turn = ev.payload.turn; });
  $('#turnChip').textContent = turn ? 'ROUND ' + turn : '待命';
  Object.keys(CUR).forEach(function (id) {
    var s = CUR[id], p = participant(id), u = $('#unit-' + id);
    if (!u) return;
    var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s.hp / p.maxHp * 100));
    var hpBar = u.querySelector('.bar.hp');
    hpBar.querySelector('i').style.width = pct + '%';
    hpBar.querySelector('span').textContent = Math.max(0, s.hp) + ' / ' + p.maxHp;
    hpBar.classList.toggle('warn', pct <= 50 && pct > 25);
    hpBar.classList.toggle('low', pct <= 25);
    u.querySelector('.bar.en i').style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s.en / p.maxEnergy * 100)) + '%';
    u.querySelector('.u-en').textContent = 'EN ' + s.en + ' / ' + p.maxEnergy;
    var bf = u.querySelector('.u-buffs'); bf.innerHTML = '';
    (s.buffs || []).forEach(function (b) { bf.appendChild(el('span', 'bf', b.name + (b.stacks > 1 ? ' ×' + b.stacks : ''))); });
    u.classList.toggle('dead', s.hp <= 0);
  });
  var endEv = EVS.find(function (e) { return e.phase === 'battle_lifecycle' && e.payload.action === 'battle_end'; });
  $('#stageOverlay').classList.toggle('show', !!(endEv && P.t >= endEv.timestamp));
  if (endEv) $('#ovSub').textContent = pname(LOG.winner) + ' 获胜 · ' + fmt(endEv.timestamp);
}
function rebuildState(t) {
  P.t = Math.max(0, Math.min(P.dur, t));
  CUR = freshSim(); firedIdx = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < EVS.length; i++) { if (EVS[i].timestamp > P.t) break; applyEventToSim(CUR, EVS[i]); firedIdx = i + 1; }
  paintState();
}
function floatNum(unitId, text, cls) {
  var u = $('#unit-' + unitId); if (!u) return;
  var f = el('div', 'float-num ' + (cls || ''), text);
  f.style.left = (35 + Math.random() * 30) + '%';
  u.querySelector('.floats').appendChild(f);
  setTimeout(function () { f.remove(); }, 960);
}
var bannerTimer = null;
function setBanner(html, tone, ms) {
  var b = $('#banner');
  b.innerHTML = html; b.className = 'show b-' + tone;
  clearTimeout(bannerTimer);
  bannerTimer = setTimeout(function () { b.classList.remove('show'); }, ms || 1000);
}
function fx(ev) {
  var ph = ev.phase, pl = ev.payload || {};
  if (ph === 'battle_lifecycle') { if (pl.action === 'battle_start') setBanner('— BATTLE START —', 'amber', 1100); }
  else if (ph === 'turn_flow' && pl.action === 'start') setBanner('— ROUND ' + pl.turn + ' —', 'slate', 850);
  else if (ph === 'action_execution') {
    var au = $('#unit-' + ev.sourceId);
    if (au) { au.classList.add('acting'); setTimeout(function () { au.classList.remove('acting'); }, 750); }
    setBanner('⚔ ' + (pl.skill || '行动'), 'blue', 850);
  } else if (ph === 'damage_calculation') {
    if (pl.dodge) floatNum(ev.targetId, 'DODGE', 'dodge');
    else {
      floatNum(ev.targetId, (pl.crit ? 'CRIT ' : '−') + pl.result, pl.crit ? 'crit' : '');
      var tu = $('#unit-' + ev.targetId);
      if (tu) { tu.classList.remove('hitfx'); void tu.offsetWidth; tu.classList.add('hitfx'); }
      if (pl.death) setTimeout(function () { floatNum(ev.targetId, 'DEFEAT', 'dodge'); }, 260);
    }
  } else if (ph === 'buff_lifecycle') {
    if (pl.resisted) floatNum(ev.targetId, '抵抗', 'resist');
    else if (pl.action === 'update') floatNum(ev.targetId, pl.buff + ' ×' + pl.stacks, 'buffup');
  } else if (ph === 'passive_trigger') setBanner('⚡ 被动 · ' + pl.passive, 'cyan', 1150);
}
function fire(ev) { applyEventToSim(CUR, ev); paintState(); fx(ev); }
function updateCursorUI() {
  $('#timeRead').textContent = fmt(P.t);
  var c = $('#seekCur'); if (c) c.style.left = (P.t / P.dur * 100) + '%';
  var last = null;
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { if (e.timestamp <= P.t) last = e; });
  $('#phaseChip').textContent = last ? (PHASE_META[last.phase].label + ' · ' + last.id) : '—';
  document.querySelectorAll('#rpStream .srow').forEach(function (r) {
    var e = BYID[r.dataset.eid]; if (!e) return;
    r.classList.toggle('past', e.timestamp <= P.t);
    r.classList.toggle('cur', !!(last && e.id === last.id));
  });
  if (P.playing && P.follow && state.mode === 'replay' && last) {
    var row = document.querySelector('#rpStream .srow[data-eid="' + last.id + '"]');
    var box = $('#rpStream');
    if (row && box) {
      var rt = row.offsetTop, rh = row.offsetHeight, st = box.scrollTop, vh = box.clientHeight;
      if (rt < st + 30 || rt + rh > st + vh - 30) box.scrollTop = rt - vh / 2;
    }
  }
}
function tickLoop(now) {
  if (!P.playing) return;
  var dt = now - P.last; P.last = now;
  P.t = Math.min(P.dur, P.t + dt * P.speed);
  while (firedIdx < EVS.length && EVS[firedIdx].timestamp <= P.t) { fire(EVS[firedIdx]); firedIdx++; }
  updateCursorUI();
  if (P.t >= P.dur) { pause(); return; }
  P.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickLoop);
}
function play() {
  if (P.t >= P.dur) rebuildState(0);
  P.playing = true; P.last = performance.now();
  $('#btnPlay').textContent = '⏸';
  P.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickLoop);
}
function pause() {
  P.playing = false; $('#btnPlay').textContent = '▶';
  if (P.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(P.raf);
}
function seekTo(t, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var wasPlaying = P.playing;
  pause();
  rebuildState(t);
  if (opts.fireIds) opts.fireIds.forEach(function (id) { var e = BYID[id]; if (e) fx(e); });
  updateCursorUI();
  if (opts.autoplay || (wasPlaying && opts.keepPlay)) play();
}
function stepEvent(dir) {
  var target = null;
  if (dir > 0) target = EVS.find(function (e) { return e.timestamp > P.t + 1; });
  else { for (var i = EVS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (EVS[i].timestamp < P.t - 1) { target = EVS[i]; break; } }
  if (target) focusEvent(target.id, { seek: true, fx: state.mode === 'replay' });
}
/* ════ 回放侧事件流行 ════ */
function renderReplayStream() {
  var box = $('#rpStream'); box.innerHTML = '';
  var shown = 0;
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) {
    var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
    if (meta.debugOnly && !state.showDbg) return;
    shown++;
    var sep = ev.phase === 'turn_flow', root = ev.phase === 'battle_lifecycle';
    var r = el('div', 'srow' + (sep ? ' sep' : '') + (root ? ' root' : ''));
    r.dataset.eid = ev.id;
    r.innerHTML = '<span class="s-time">' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</span><span class="s-ico ' + meta.cls + '">' + meta.icon + '</span><span class="s-sum">' + ev.summary + '</span>' +
      (meta.debugOnly ? '<span class="s-dbg">DEBUG</span>' : '');
    r.addEventListener('click', function () { focusEvent(ev.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
    box.appendChild(r);
  });
  $('#rpCount').textContent = shown + ' / ' + EVS.length;
}
function buildSeek() {
  var seek = $('#seek');
  seek.querySelectorAll('.tick,.cur').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); });
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) {
    var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
    if (meta.debugOnly && !state.showDbg) return;
    if (ev.phase === 'turn_flow' && ev.payload.action === 'start') {
      var tm = el('i', 'tick tm');
      tm.style.left = (ev.timestamp / P.dur * 100) + '%';
      tm.title = 'ROUND ' + ev.payload.turn + ' · ' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + ' · 点击跳转回合';
      tm.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); seekTo(ev.timestamp, { keepPlay: true }); });
      seek.appendChild(tm);
    }
    var tk = el('i', 'tick ' + meta.tick);
    tk.style.left = (ev.timestamp / P.dur * 100) + '%';
    tk.title = fmt(ev.timestamp) + ' · ' + ev.summary;
    tk.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); focusEvent(ev.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
    seek.appendChild(tk);
  });
  var cur = el('b', 'cur'); cur.id = 'seekCur'; cur.style.left = '0%';
  seek.appendChild(cur);
  seek.onclick = function (e) {
    var rect = seek.getBoundingClientRect();
    seekTo((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * P.dur, { keepPlay: true });
  };
}
/* ════ 调试侧：时间线树 ════ */
function nodeDotOf(n) {
  var death = n.events.some(function (e) { return (e.payload && e.payload.death) || (e.phase === 'battle_lifecycle' && e.payload.action === 'battle_end'); });
  var crit = n.events.some(function (e) { return e.payload && e.payload.crit; });
  var dodge = n.events.some(function (e) { return e.payload && e.payload.dodge; });
  if (death) return 'var(--red)';
  if (crit) return 'var(--amber)';
  if (dodge) return 'var(--cyan)';
  return null;
}
function renderDebugTree() {
  var box = $('#dbTree'); box.innerHTML = '';
  DEBUG_NODES.forEach(function (entry) {
    if (entry.kind === 'round') {
      var rw = el('div', 't-round');
      var row = el('div', 't-row');
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="t-tgl open">▶</span><span class="t-ico">◈</span><span class="t-lab">' + entry.name + '</span><span class="t-meta">' + entry.nodes.length + ' 节点</span>';
      var kids = el('div', 't-kids open');
      row.addEventListener('click', function () { row.querySelector('.t-tgl').classList.toggle('open'); kids.classList.toggle('open'); });
      entry.nodes.forEach(function (n) { kids.appendChild(makeNodeRow(n)); });
      rw.appendChild(row); rw.appendChild(kids); box.appendChild(rw);
    } else box.appendChild(makeNodeRow(entry));
  });
  $('#treeMeta').textContent = DEBUG_NODES.filter(function (e) { return e.kind === 'round'; }).length + ' ROUNDS';
}
function makeNodeRow(n) {
  var r = el('div', 't-row' + (state.debugNode === n.id ? ' on' : ''));
  r.dataset.nid = n.id;
  var dot = nodeDotOf(n);
  r.innerHTML = '<span class="t-ico">' + n.icon + '</span><span class="t-lab">' + n.name + '</span>' +
    (n.meta ? '<span class="t-meta">' + n.meta + '</span>' : '') +
    (dot ? '<span class="t-dot" style="background:' + dot + ';box-shadow:0 0 6px ' + dot + '"></span>' : '');
  r.addEventListener('click', function () { selectDebugNode(n.id); });
  return r;
}
/* ════ 调试侧：卡片流（v2 风格 + 虚拟列表） ════ */
var CARDS_CTX = { hits: 0, segResults: null };
var VL = {
  items: [], nodes: new Map(), heights: new Map(), offsets: [], EST: 122, GAP: 12, PAD: 16, anim: false, _raf: false, _sraf: false,
  setItems: function (items, animate) {
    this.items = items; this.nodes.clear(); this.heights.clear();
    this.inner.textContent = ''; this.inner.style.height = '0px';
    this.scroll.scrollTop = 0; this.anim = !!animate; this.layout();
  },
  layout: function () {
    var n = this.items.length, y = this.PAD, i;
    this.offsets = new Array(n);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { this.offsets[i] = y; y += (this.heights.get(this.items[i].id) || this.EST) + this.GAP; }
    this.inner.style.height = (y + this.PAD) + 'px';
    var st = this.scroll.scrollTop, vh = this.scroll.clientHeight;
    var lo = 0, hi = n - 1, start = 0;
    while (lo <= hi) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (this.offsets[mid] < st - 240) { lo = mid + 1; start = lo; } else hi = mid - 1; }
    var end = start;
    while (end < n && this.offsets[end] < st + vh + 240) end++;
    var seen = new Set(), self = this;
    for (i = start; i < end; i++) {
      var ev = this.items[i]; seen.add(ev.id);
      var node = this.nodes.get(ev.id);
      if (!node) {
        node = createEventCard(ev, i, this.anim);
        node.style.position = 'absolute'; node.style.left = '16px'; node.style.right = '16px';
        this.nodes.set(ev.id, node); this.inner.appendChild(node);
      }
      node.style.top = this.offsets[i] + 'px';
    }
    this.nodes.forEach(function (node, id) { if (!seen.has(id)) { node.remove(); self.nodes.delete(id); } });
    var changed = false;
    this.nodes.forEach(function (node, id) {
      if (!self.heights.has(id)) { var h = node.offsetHeight; if (h > 0) { self.heights.set(id, h); changed = true; } }
    });
    if (changed && !this._raf) { this._raf = true; requestAnimationFrame(function () { self._raf = false; self.layout(); }); }
    this.anim = false;
  },
  ensureVisible: function (id) {
    var i = this.items.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
    if (i < 0) return;
    var h = this.heights.get(id) || this.EST, top = this.offsets[i], st = this.scroll.scrollTop, vh = this.scroll.clientHeight;
    if (top < st + 20) this.scroll.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top - 40);
    else if (top + h > st + vh - 20) this.scroll.scrollTop = top + h - vh + 40;
  }
};
function descOf(ev) {
  var s = ev.summary;
  s = s.replace(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g, '<span class="hd">$1</span>');
  s = s.replace(/暴击/g, '<span class="hc">暴击</span>');
  s = s.replace(/闪避/g, '<span class="hc" style="color:var(--cyan)">闪避</span>');
  s = s.replace(/抵抗/g, '<span class="hc" style="color:var(--orange)">抵抗</span>');
  s = s.replace(/阵亡/g, '<b style="color:var(--red)">阵亡</b>');
  return s;
}
function cardTone(ev) {
  var pl = ev.payload || {};
  if (pl.death) return 'death';
  if (ev.phase === 'damage_calculation') { if (pl.dodge) return 'miss'; if (pl.crit) return 'crit'; return 'damage'; }
  if (ev.phase === 'heal_calculation') return 'heal';
  if (ev.phase === 'buff_lifecycle') return pl.resisted ? 'debuff' : 'buff';
  if (ev.phase === 'passive_trigger') return 'passive';
  if (ev.phase === 'action_execution') return 'action';
  return 'phase';
}
function badgeOf(ev) {
  var pl = ev.payload || {};
  if (PHASE_META[ev.phase].debugOnly) return ['b-dbg', 'DEBUG'];
  if (ev.phase === 'damage_calculation') {
    if (pl.dodge) return ['b-miss', 'DODGE'];
    if (pl.death) return ['b-death', 'KILL'];
    if (pl.crit) return ['b-crit', 'CRIT'];
    return ['b-hit', 'HIT'];
  }
  if (ev.phase === 'buff_lifecycle') return pl.resisted ? ['b-resist', 'RESIST'] : (pl.action === 'update' ? ['b-ok', 'DECAY'] : ['b-hit', 'APPLY']);
  if (ev.phase === 'passive_trigger') return ['b-miss', 'TRIGGER'];
  if (ev.phase === 'action_execution') return ['b-hit', 'ACT'];
  return ['b-ok', 'SYS'];
}
function buildSegResults(node) {
  var res = [];
  for (var i = 1; i <= node.hits; i++) {
    var dmg = node.events.find(function (e) { return e.phase === 'damage_calculation' && e.payload && e.payload.seg === i; });
    res.push(dmg ? (dmg.payload.dodge ? 'm' : dmg.payload.crit ? 'c' : 'h') : 'h');
  }
  return res;
}
function createEventCard(ev, i, animate) {
  var dbgOnly = !!PHASE_META[ev.phase].debugOnly;
  var node = el('div', 'ev t-' + cardTone(ev) + (ev.id === state.sel ? ' on' : '') + (dbgOnly ? ' dbg-dim' : ''));
  if (animate) {
    node.style.animation = 'cardIn .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both';
    node.style.animationDelay = Math.min(i * 26, 260) + 'ms';
  }
  var bd = badgeOf(ev);
  var hd = '<div class="ev-hd">';
  if (ev.payload && ev.payload.seg) hd += '<span class="ev-step">SEG ' + ev.payload.seg + '</span>';
  hd += '<span class="ev-title">' + ev.summary + '</span><span class="ev-badge ' + bd[0] + '">' + bd[1] + '</span></div>';
  var body = '<div class="ev-bd">' + descOf(ev) + '</div>';
  var meta = '<div class="ev-meta">' + ev.correlationId + (ev.parentId ? ' · ← ' + ev.parentId : '') +
    (ev.sourceId ? ' · ' + ev.sourceId : '') + (ev.targetId ? ' → ' + ev.targetId : '') + ' · t=' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</div>';
  var multi = '';
  if (CARDS_CTX.hits > 1 && ev.payload && ev.payload.seg) {
    multi = '<div class="ev-multi">' + CARDS_CTX.segResults.map(function (m, j) {
      return '<i class="' + (m === 'c' ? 'c' : m === 'm' ? 'm' : 'h') + (ev.payload.seg === j + 1 ? ' cur' : '') + '"></i>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  node.innerHTML = hd + body + meta + multi;
  node.addEventListener('click', function () { focusEvent(ev.id, { seek: true }); });
  return node;
}
function selectDebugNode(nid) {
  var node = allNodesFlat().find(function (n) { return n.id === nid; });
  if (!node) return;
  state.debugNode = nid;
  document.querySelectorAll('.t-row.on').forEach(function (n) { n.classList.remove('on'); });
  var row = document.querySelector('.t-row[data-nid="' + nid + '"]');
  if (row) row.classList.add('on');
  $('#shTitle').textContent = node.name + (node.action ? ' · 行动日志' : ' · 阶段结算');
  $('#shSub').innerHTML = node.action
    ? 'ACTOR <b>' + pname(node.actor) + '</b> → TARGET <b>' + pname(node.target) + '</b> · ' + node.events.length + ' EVENTS'
    : 'SYSTEM PHASE · ' + node.events.length + ' EVENTS';
  if (node.action && node.hits > 1) { CARDS_CTX.hits = node.hits; CARDS_CTX.segResults = buildSegResults(node); }
  else { CARDS_CTX.hits = 0; CARDS_CTX.segResults = null; }
  VL.setItems(node.events, true);
  $('#dbCount').textContent = node.events.length + ' EVENTS';
}
/* ════ 检视器（共用渲染器） ════ */
function emptyInspector() {
  return '<div class="insp-empty-wrap"><div class="insp-empty">点击任意事件以检视底层数据<br>回放与调试共用同一渲染数据源（ADR §5.1）</div>' +
    '<div class="kbd-hints"><span><b>1</b> / <b>2</b> 切换 回放 / 调试 系统</span><span><b>空格</b> 播放 / 暂停 · <b>←</b>/<b>→</b> 逐事件</span><span>调试系统内 <b>↑</b>/<b>↓</b> 卡片导航</span></div></div>';
}
function countUp(node, target) {
  var t0 = performance.now(), dur = 550;
  (function f(t) { var p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / dur); p = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
    node.textContent = Math.round(target * p); if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(f); })(t0);
}
function fmtVal(op, v) { if (op === '×') return '× ' + v; if (op === '−') return '− ' + Math.abs(v); if (op === '+') return '+ ' + v; return String(v); }
function secFormula(steps, result) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">计算过程 · PAYLOAD.STEPS</div>';
  var fbox = el('div', 'fbox ticked');
  steps.forEach(function (m) {
    var opCls = m.op === '×' ? 'mul' : (m.op === '−' ? 'sub' : 'add');
    var vCls = m.op === '×' ? 'mul' : ((m.op === '−' || m.v < 0) ? 'neg' : 'pos');
    var row = el('div', 'frow');
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="fop ' + opCls + '">' + (m.op || '＝') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="flab">' + m.n + '<span class="src">' + m.src + '</span></span>' +
      '<span class="fval ' + vCls + '">' + fmtVal(m.op, m.v) + '</span>';
    fbox.appendChild(row);
  });
  if (result != null) {
    var res = el('div', 'fres');
    res.innerHTML = '<span class="lab">FINAL · 结算结果</span><span class="num" data-v="' + result + '">0</span>';
    fbox.appendChild(res);
  }
  wrap.appendChild(fbox);
  return wrap;
}
var ROLL_NAME = { hit: '命中判定', crit: '暴击判定', resist: '效果抵抗', passive: '被动触发率' };
function secRng(rolls) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">随机判定凭证 · PAYLOAD.ROLLS</div>';
  rolls.forEach(function (c) {
    var pass = c.roll < c.rate, pct = (c.roll * 100).toFixed(1), th = (c.rate * 100).toFixed(1);
    var item = el('div', 'rng');
    item.innerHTML = '<div class="rng-top"><span class="rng-name">' + (ROLL_NAME[c.kind] || c.kind) + '</span>' +
      (c.buff ? '<span class="rng-note">· ' + c.buff + '</span>' : '') +
      '<span class="rng-idx">RNG #' + String(c.idx || 0).padStart(4, '0') + ' · xorshift32</span></div>' +
      '<div class="rng-bar"><i class="rng-fill ' + (pass ? 'pass' : 'fail') + '" data-w="' + pct + '%"></i><b class="rng-th" style="left:' + th + '%"></b></div>' +
      '<div class="rng-nums"><span>阈值 <b>' + th + '%</b></span><span>ROLL <b style="color:' + (pass ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--cyan)') + '">' + pct + '%</b></span>' +
      '<span class="rng-verdict ' + (pass ? 'v-pass' : 'v-fail') + '">' + (pass ? '判定通过' : '判定未通过') + '</span></div>';
    wrap.appendChild(item);
  });
  return wrap;
}
function secDelta(ev) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">状态变化 · SNAPSHOT</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'dbox');
  ev._delta.forEach(function (d) {
    box.appendChild(el('div', 'd-tgt', 'PARTICIPANT · <b>' + pname(d.id) + '</b>'));
    d.fields.forEach(function (f) {
      var delta = f.after - f.before;
      var p = participant(d.id);
      var pct = f.k === 'HP' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, f.after / p.maxHp * 100)) : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, f.after / p.maxEnergy * 100));
      var row = el('div', 'drow');
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="dstat">' + f.k + '</span><span class="dbar"><i class="' + (f.k === 'HP' ? 'hp' : 'en') + '" data-w="' + pct + '%"></i></span>' +
        '<span class="dbefore">' + f.before + '</span><span class="dafter" style="color:' + (delta < 0 ? 'var(--red)' : 'var(--green)') + '">' + f.after + '</span>' +
        '<span class="ddelta ' + (delta < 0 ? 'dec' : 'inc') + '">' + (delta > 0 ? '+' : '') + delta + '</span>';
      box.appendChild(row);
    });
  });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
function secChain(nodes) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">事件因果链 · PAYLOAD.CHAIN</div>';
  nodes.forEach(function (n, i) {
    var node = el('div', 'cnode');
    node.innerHTML = '<span class="cnum">' + (i + 1) + '</span><div><div class="ct">' + n.t + '</div><div class="cd">' + n.d + '</div></div>';
    wrap.appendChild(node);
  });
  return wrap;
}
function secScores(pl) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">AI 候选评分 · PAYLOAD.CANDIDATES</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'dbox');
  pl.candidates.forEach(function (c) {
    var win = c.id === pl.chosen;
    var row = el('div', 'scrow' + (win ? ' win' : ''));
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="n">' + c.name + (win ? ' ✓' : '') + '</span><span class="b"><i data-w="' + c.score + '%"></i></span><span class="v">' + c.score + '</span>';
    box.appendChild(row);
  });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
var KV_LABEL = { skill: '技能', hits: '段数', controlMode: '控制模式', buff: 'Buff', resisted: '是否被抵抗', passive: '被动', chance: '触发概率', death: '致死', dot: '持续伤害', counter: '反击', reason: '重算原因', configs: '配置条数', validated: '校验通过', winner: '胜方', rounds: '总回合', action: '动作', engine: '引擎', seg: '段序号' };
function secKV(pl, skip) {
  var rows = [];
  Object.keys(pl).forEach(function (k) {
    if (skip.indexOf(k) >= 0) return;
    var v = pl[k];
    if (v === null || typeof v === 'object') return;
    rows.push([KV_LABEL[k] || k, String(v)]);
  });
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">载荷字段 · PAYLOAD</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'kvbox');
  rows.forEach(function (r) { box.appendChild(el('div', 'kvrow', '<span class="k">' + r[0] + '</span><span class="v">' + r[1] + '</span>')); });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
function renderInspector(ev) {
  var box = $('#insp'); box.innerHTML = '';
  var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
  var hd = el('div', 'insp-hd');
  hd.innerHTML = '<div class="insp-kicker">' + ev.id + ' · <span class="' + meta.cls + '">' + ev.phase + '</span> · ' + ev.correlationId +
    (ev.parentId ? ' · ← ' + ev.parentId : '') + ' · t=' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="insp-title">' + ev.summary + '</div>' +
    '<div class="insp-actions"><button class="btn" id="btnPlayHere">▶ 从此回放</button><button class="btn" id="btnExpEv">⇩ 导出事件 JSON</button></div>';
  box.appendChild(hd);
  $('#btnPlayHere').addEventListener('click', function () {
    setMode('replay', true);
    seekTo(ev.timestamp, { fireIds: [ev.id], autoplay: true });
    toast('已切换至回放系统，并从 ' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + ' 开始播放');
  });
  $('#btnExpEv').addEventListener('click', function () { download('event_' + ev.id + '.json', JSON.stringify(ev, null, 2)); toast('已导出事件 ' + ev.id); });
  var pl = ev.payload || {}, secs = [];
  if (pl.steps) secs.push(secFormula(pl.steps, pl.result));
  if (pl.rolls) secs.push(secRng(pl.rolls));
  if (ev._delta) secs.push(secDelta(ev));
  if (pl.chain) secs.push(secChain(pl.chain));
  if (pl.candidates) secs.push(secScores(pl));
  if (pl.fields) {
    var w2 = el('div');
    w2.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">属性重算 · PAYLOAD.FIELDS</div>';
    var b2 = el('div', 'kvbox');
    pl.fields.forEach(function (f) { b2.appendChild(el('div', 'kvrow', '<span class="k">' + f.k + '</span><span class="v">' + f.from + ' → <b style="color:var(--amber)">' + f.to + '</b></span>')); });
    w2.appendChild(b2); secs.push(w2);
  }
  var kv = secKV(pl, ['steps', 'rolls', 'chain', 'candidates', 'fields', 'anchor', 'result']);
  if (kv) secs.push(kv);
  var kids = CHILDREN[ev.id];
  if (kids && kids.length) {
    var w3 = el('div');
    w3.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">子事件 · PARENTID (' + kids.length + ')</div>';
    kids.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; }).forEach(function (c) {
      var cm = PHASE_META[c.phase];
      var r = el('div', 'childrow');
      r.innerHTML = '<span class="ci ' + cm.cls + '">' + cm.icon + '</span><span class="cs">' + c.summary + '</span><span class="ctm">' + fmt(c.timestamp) + '</span>';
      r.addEventListener('click', function () { focusEvent(c.id, { seek: true }); });
      w3.appendChild(r);
    });
    secs.push(w3);
  }
  secs.forEach(function (s, idx) { if (s) { s.classList.add('sec'); s.style.animationDelay = (idx * 70) + 'ms'; box.appendChild(s); } });
  requestAnimationFrame(function () { requestAnimationFrame(function () {
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-w]').forEach(function (n) { n.style.width = n.dataset.w; });
    var num = box.querySelector('.fres .num');
    if (num) countUp(num, +num.dataset.v);
  }); });
}
/* ════ 选择 / 焦点 / 深链 ════ */
function markSel() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#rpStream .srow').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.toggle('sel', r.dataset.eid === state.sel); });
  VL.nodes.forEach(function (node, id) { node.classList.toggle('on', id === state.sel); });
}
function selectEvent(id, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var ev = BYID[id]; if (!ev) return;
  state.sel = id;
  renderInspector(ev);
  markSel();
  if (opts.seek) seekTo(ev.timestamp, { fireIds: opts.fx ? [id] : [] });
  syncHash();
}
function focusEvent(id, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  if (state.mode === 'debug') {
    var node = nodeOfEvent(id);
    if (node && node.id !== state.debugNode) selectDebugNode(node.id);
  }
  selectEvent(id, opts);
  if (state.mode === 'debug') VL.ensureVisible(id);
}
function syncHash() {
  var h = '#m=' + state.mode;
  if (state.sel) h += '&e=' + state.sel;
  try { history.replaceState(null, '', h); } catch (err) {}
}
function applyDeepLink() {
  var mm = location.hash.match(/m=(replay|debug)/), me = location.hash.match(/e=([\w]+)/);
  if (mm) state.mode = mm[1];
  setMode(state.mode, true);
  if (me && BYID[me[1]]) { focusEvent(me[1], { seek: true }); return true; }
  return false;
}
function copyDeepLink() {
  var url = location.href, done = function () { toast('深链已复制 — 含模式与事件定位'); };
  var fb = function () { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = url; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {} ta.remove(); done(); };
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(fb); else fb();
}
/* ════ 模式切换 ════ */
function setMode(m, silent) {
  state.mode = m;
  $('#modeReplay').classList.toggle('on', m === 'replay');
  $('#modeDebug').classList.toggle('on', m === 'debug');
  (m === 'replay' ? $('#inspShellRp') : $('#inspShellDbg')).appendChild($('#insp'));
  $('#modeSwitch').dataset.mode = m;
  $('#modeSwitch').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.m === m); });
  $('#stMode').textContent = 'MODE ' + (m === 'replay' ? 'REPLAY' : 'DEBUG');
  if (m === 'replay') updateCursorUI();
  else { VL.layout(); markSel(); }
  if (!silent) toast(m === 'replay' ? '回放系统 — 按 timestamp 播放 · StateDelta 快照跳转' : '调试系统 — 时间线树 / 卡片流 / RNG 凭证 · 按 correlationId 消费');
  syncHash();
}
/* ════ 状态栏 / 诊断 ════ */
function updateStatus() {
  var v = VAL;
  $('#stSchema').innerHTML = 'STREAM v' + LOG.version + ' · <span class="' + (v.errors.length ? 'st-warn' : 'st-ok') + '">' + v.errors.length + ' 错误 / ' + v.warnings.length + ' 警告</span>';
  $('#stEvents').textContent = '事件 ' + v.stats.events + ' · 因果链 ' + v.stats.chains;
  $('#stAnchors').textContent = '锚点 ' + v.stats.anchorsEv + ' 增量 + ' + v.stats.anchorsTurn + ' 全量';
  $('#stSeed').textContent = 'SEED ' + LOG.randomSeed + ' · 解析 ' + (TIMINGS.parse + TIMINGS.validate).toFixed(1) + 'ms';
  $('#cmdMeta').innerHTML = 'BATTLE <b>' + LOG.battleId + '</b><br>RECORDED <b>' + new Date(LOG.startTime).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ') + '</b>';
}
function openDiag() {
  var list = $('#diagList'); list.innerHTML = '';
  var rows = [];
  rows.push(['info', '格式', 'events[0] 含 phase + correlationId → 统一事件流，双工作台全功能']);
  rows.push(['ok', '时基', 'battle_start 为相对零点 · performance.now() 单调时基']);
  if (VAL.errors.length) VAL.errors.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['err', '错误', x]); });
  else rows.push(['ok', '校验', '结构校验通过 — ' + VAL.stats.events + ' 事件 / ' + VAL.stats.checks + ' 次随机判定']);
  VAL.warnings.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['warn', '警告', x]); });
  VAL.infos.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['info', '索引', x]); });
  rows.push(['info', '性能', '解析 ' + TIMINGS.parse.toFixed(1) + 'ms · 校验 ' + TIMINGS.validate.toFixed(1) + 'ms（工作线程）']);
  rows.push(['info', '裁决', '回放与调试是同一数据源的两个投影 — 无第二份事件序列']);
  rows.forEach(function (r) { list.appendChild(el('div', 'dl', '<span class="tag ' + r[0] + '">' + r[1] + '</span><span>' + r[2] + '</span>')); });
  $('#diag').classList.add('open');
}
/* ════ 启动 ════ */
function bootLine(html) { var i = bootLineIdx++; setTimeout(function () { $('#bootLines').appendChild(el('div', 'bl', html)); }, i * 165); }
function setBar(p) { var i = bootLineIdx; setTimeout(function () { $('#bootBar').style.width = p + '%'; }, i * 165); }
function boot() {
  var t0 = performance.now(), raw = JSON.stringify(ARCHIVE);
  bootLine('> 载入存档 ............... <span class="ok">OK</span> <span class="dim">v2.0.0 · ' + ARCHIVE.events.length + ' 事件 · ' + (raw.length / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB</span>'); setBar(12);
  runPipeline(raw, function (res) {
    LOG = res.log; VAL = res.validation; TIMINGS = res.timings;
    bootLine('> 格式检测 .............. <span class="ok">统一事件流</span> <span class="dim">phase + correlationId → 双工作台全功能</span>'); setBar(32);
    bootLine('> 时基与因果校验 ........ <span class="' + (VAL.errors.length ? 'warn' : 'ok') + '">' + (VAL.errors.length ? '异常' : 'OK') + '</span> <span class="dim">' + VAL.stats.chains + ' 条因果链 · 父引用全部解析</span>'); setBar(50);
    bootLine('> <span class="cy">投影 1 · 回放舞台</span> ...... <span class="ok">就绪</span> <span class="dim">timestamp 播放 · StateDelta 跳转 · 倍速</span>'); setBar(68);
    bootLine('> <span class="am">投影 2 · 调试工作台</span> .... <span class="ok">就绪</span> <span class="dim">时间线树 · 卡片流 · RNG 凭证 · ↑↓ 导航</span>'); setBar(86);
    bootLine('> 就绪 · 按 <span class="cy">1</span> / <span class="am">2</span> 随时切换两个系统'); setBar(100);
    buildIndices(); deriveDebugTree();
    buildStage(); buildSeek();
    renderReplayStream(); renderDebugTree();
    $('#insp').remove();
    var insp = el('div'); insp.id = 'insp';
    $('#modeSwitch'); // noop keep order
    document.body.appendChild(insp);
    insp.outerHTML = '<div id="insp"></div>';
    $('#inspShellRp').appendChild($('#insp'));
    $('#insp').innerHTML = emptyInspector();
    var firstNode = allNodesFlat().find(function (n) { return n.action; }) || allNodesFlat()[0];
    if (firstNode) selectDebugNode(firstNode.id);
    updateStatus();
    rebuildState(0); updateCursorUI();
    var wait = Math.max(0, 1500 - (performance.now() - t0));
    setTimeout(function () {
      $('#boot').classList.add('done');
      var linked = applyDeepLink();
      if (!linked) {
        setMode(state.mode, true);
        if (state.mode === 'replay') setTimeout(function () { play(); }, 400);
      }
    }, bootSkip ? 0 : wait);
  });
  $('#boot').addEventListener('click', function () { bootSkip = true; if (LOG) $('#boot').classList.add('done'); });
}
/* ════ 事件绑定 ════ */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  // 独立的 #insp 元素由启动流程挂载，此处先占位
  var holder = el('div'); holder.id = 'insp';
  $('#inspShellRp').appendChild(holder);
  VL.scroll = $('#dbScroll'); VL.inner = $('#dbInner');
  VL.scroll.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    if (!VL._sraf) { VL._sraf = true; requestAnimationFrame(function () { VL._sraf = false; VL.layout(); }); }
  }, { passive: true });
  $('#modeSwitch').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () { setMode(this.dataset.m); this.blur(); });
  });
  $('#btnPlay').addEventListener('click', function () { P.playing ? pause() : play(); this.blur(); });
  $('#btnStart').addEventListener('click', function () { seekTo(0); });
  $('#btnEnd').addEventListener('click', function () { seekTo(P.dur); });
  $('#btnPrev').addEventListener('click', function () { stepEvent(-1); });
  $('#btnNext').addEventListener('click', function () { stepEvent(1); });
  $('#btnFollow').addEventListener('click', function () { P.follow = !P.follow; this.classList.toggle('on', P.follow); });
  $('#speedSeg').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      P.speed = +this.dataset.s;
      $('#speedSeg').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('on'); });
      this.classList.add('on');
    });
  });
  $('#btnDbg').addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.showDbg = !state.showDbg;
    this.textContent = state.showDbg ? '调试专属 · 显示' : '调试专属 · 隐藏';
    this.classList.toggle('on', state.showDbg);
    renderReplayStream(); buildSeek(); updateCursorUI();
    toast(state.showDbg ? '回放投影已显示调试专属事件' : '回放投影已按 §5.2 分类表隐藏调试专属事件（调试系统始终可见）');
  });
  $('#btnLink').addEventListener('click', copyDeepLink);
  $('#btnExport').addEventListener('click', function () {
    download('battle_debug_' + LOG.battleId + '_v' + LOG.version + '.json', JSON.stringify(LOG, null, 2));
    toast('已导出统一存档 — 一份文件，回放与调试两种能力');
  });
  $('#stSchema').addEventListener('click', function () { $('#diag').classList.toggle('open'); openDiag(); });
  $('#btnDiagClose').addEventListener('click', function () { $('#diag').classList.remove('open'); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
    if (e.key === '1') { setMode('replay'); return; }
    if (e.key === '2') { setMode('debug'); return; }
    if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); P.playing ? pause() : play(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); stepEvent(1); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); stepEvent(-1); }
    else if ((e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') && state.mode === 'debug') {
      e.preventDefault();
      var items = VL.items; if (!items.length) return;
      var i = items.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === state.sel; });
      i = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(items.length - 1, i + 1) : Math.max(0, i < 0 ? 0 : i - 1);
      focusEvent(items[i].id, { seek: true });
    }
    else if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') { $('#btnFollow').click(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { $('#diag').classList.remove('open'); }
  });
  setInterval(function () {
    var d = new Date();
    $('#stClock').textContent = 'UTC ' + String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
  }, 1000);
  boot();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
'use strict';
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   §5.2 · phase → 分类映射（唯一一张表）
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var PHASE_META = {
  battle_lifecycle:{ label:'生命周期', icon:'◉', cls:'c-amber', tick:'tc-amber' },
  turn_flow:{ label:'回合流转', icon:'◇', cls:'c-slate', tick:'tc-slate' },
  action_execution:{ label:'行动', icon:'⚔', cls:'c-blue', tick:'tc-blue' },
  damage_calculation:{ label:'伤害', icon:'✦', cls:'c-red', tick:'tc-red' },
  heal_calculation:{ label:'治疗', icon:'✚', cls:'c-green', tick:'tc-green' },
  buff_lifecycle:{ label:'Buff', icon:'❖', cls:'c-orange', tick:'tc-orange' },
  passive_trigger:{ label:'被动', icon:'⚡', cls:'c-cyan', tick:'tc-cyan' },
  ai_decision:{ label:'AI决策', icon:'◈', cls:'c-dbg', tick:'tc-dbg', debugOnly:true },
  attribute_recalc:{ label:'属性重算', icon:'∑', cls:'c-dbg', tick:'tc-dbg', debugOnly:true },
  config_load:{ label:'配置', icon:'⚙', cls:'c-dbg', tick:'tc-dbg', debugOnly:true }
};
var DEBUG_PHASES = ['ai_decision','attribute_recalc','config_load'];
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   校验器（纯函数 · 注入 Worker 执行，仅字符串拼接）
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function validateUnified(log, debugPhases) {
  var errors = [], warnings = [], infos = [], evs = log.events || [];
  var stats = { events: evs.length, chains: 0, anchorsEv: 0, anchorsTurn: 0, checks: 0, debugOnly: 0 };
  if (log.version !== '2.0.0') errors.push('版本号异常: ' + log.version);
  var first = evs[0];
  if (!first || first.phase !== 'battle_lifecycle' || !(first.payload && first.payload.action === 'battle_start')) errors.push('首事件必须为 battle_start 根事件');
  else {
    if (first.timestamp !== 0) errors.push('battle_start 时基零点偏移: ' + first.timestamp);
    if (!first.randomSeed) errors.push('battle_start 未携带 randomSeed');
  }
  var ids = {}, i, ev;
  for (i = 0; i < evs.length; i++) ids[evs[i].id] = evs[i];
  var corr = {};
  var lastTs = -1;
  for (i = 0; i < evs.length; i++) {
    ev = evs[i];
    if (ev.timestamp < lastTs) errors.push('时基非单调: ' + ev.id + ' (' + ev.timestamp + ' < ' + lastTs + ')');
    lastTs = ev.timestamp;
    if (!ev.correlationId) errors.push('事件缺少 correlationId: ' + ev.id);
    else corr[ev.correlationId] = true;
    if (ev.parentId && !ids[ev.parentId]) errors.push('父引用悬空: ' + ev.id + ' → ' + ev.parentId);
    if (debugPhases.indexOf(ev.phase) >= 0) stats.debugOnly++;
    if (ev.phase === 'turn_flow' && ev.payload && ev.payload.anchor) stats.anchorsTurn++;
    if (ev.snapshot) stats.anchorsEv++;
    var rolls = ev.payload && ev.payload.rolls;
    if (rolls) for (var j = 0; j < rolls.length; j++) {
      stats.checks++;
      if (rolls[j].roll < 0 || rolls[j].roll > 1) errors.push('随机值越界: ' + ev.id);
    }
  }
  stats.chains = Object.keys(corr).length;
  var hasEnd = evs.some(function (e) { return e.phase === 'battle_lifecycle' && e.payload && e.payload.action === 'battle_end'; });
  if (!hasEnd) warnings.push('缺少 battle_end 根事件');
  if (stats.debugOnly > 0) warnings.push(stats.debugOnly + ' 个调试专属事件（' + debugPhases.join('/') + '）— 按 §5.2 分类表默认不上回放舞台');
  infos.push('随机判定 ' + stats.checks + ' 次 · 因果链 ' + stats.chains + ' 条');
  infos.push('锚点体系：事件级增量 ×' + stats.anchorsEv + ' + 回合级全量 ×' + stats.anchorsTurn + '（+ initialState）');
  return { errors: errors, warnings: warnings, infos: infos, stats: stats };
}
var workerSource = [
  'var DEBUG_PHASES = ' + JSON.stringify(DEBUG_PHASES) + ';',
  validateUnified.toString(),
  'self.onmessage = function (e) {',
  '  var t0 = performance.now();',
  '  var log = JSON.parse(e.data);',
  '  var t1 = performance.now();',
  '  var v = validateUnified(log, DEBUG_PHASES);',
  '  var t2 = performance.now();',
  '  self.postMessage({ log: log, validation: v, timings: { parse: t1 - t0, validate: t2 - t1 } });',
  '};'
].join('\n');
function runPipeline(str, onDone) {
  var w = null;
  try { w = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([workerSource], { type: 'application/javascript' }))); } catch (err) { w = null; }
  if (w) {
    w.onmessage = function (e) { onDone(e.data); };
    w.onerror = function () {
      var t0 = performance.now(), log = JSON.parse(str), t1 = performance.now();
      var v = validateUnified(log, DEBUG_PHASES), t2 = performance.now();
      onDone({ log: log, validation: v, timings: { parse: t1 - t0, validate: t2 - t1 } });
    };
    w.postMessage(str);
  } else {
    var t0 = performance.now(), log2 = JSON.parse(str), t1 = performance.now();
    var v2 = validateUnified(log2, DEBUG_PHASES), t2 = performance.now();
    setTimeout(function () { onDone({ log: log2, validation: v2, timings: { parse: t1 - t0, validate: t2 - t1 } }); }, 60);
  }
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════

   （§4.4 时基：battle_start 为相对零点；§4.3 StateDelta：
    snapshot 记录变更后绝对值；回合级全量锚点置于 turn_flow payload.anchor）
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

    { id:'ev19', phase:'battle_lifecycle', correlationId:'corr_end', timestamp:3600, level:'info',
      payload:{ action:'battle_end', winner:'u1', rounds:2 }, summary:'战斗结束 · 剑士获胜' }
  ]
};
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   全局状态
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var LOG = null, VAL = null, TIMINGS = null;
var EVS = [], BYID = {}, CHILDREN = {};
var CUR = {};            // 当前舞台状态（增量维护）
var state = { sel:null, showDbg:false };
var P = { t:0, playing:false, speed:1, dur:0, last:0, raf:null, follow:true };
var firedIdx = 0, bootSkip = false, bootLineIdx = 0;
var $ = function (s) { return document.querySelector(s); };
function el(tag, cls, html) { var n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (html != null) n.innerHTML = html; return n; }
function fmt(t) { var m = Math.floor(t / 60000), s = Math.floor(t % 60000 / 1000), x = Math.floor(t % 1000);
  return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0') + '.' + String(x).padStart(3, '0'); }
function toast(msg) { var t = el('div', 'toast-item', msg); $('#toast').appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(function () { t.style.opacity = '0'; t.style.transition = 'opacity .3s'; setTimeout(function () { t.remove(); }, 320); }, 2400); }
function download(name, text) { var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: 'application/json' })); a.download = name; a.click();
  setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 500); }
function participant(id) { return LOG.initialState.participants.find(function (p) { return p.id === id; }); }
function pname(id) { var p = participant(id); return p ? p.name : id; }
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   索引构建：rng 序号 + 快照前后值（_delta）
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function buildIndices() {
  EVS = LOG.events.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; });
  BYID = {}; CHILDREN = {};
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { BYID[e.id] = e; });
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { if (e.parentId) { (CHILDREN[e.parentId] = CHILDREN[e.parentId] || []).push(e); } });
  var rng = 0, sim = {};
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p) { sim[p.id] = { hp: p.hp, en: p.energy }; });
  EVS.forEach(function (e) {
    if (e.payload && e.payload.rolls) e.payload.rolls.forEach(function (r) { r.idx = ++rng; });
    var deltas = [];
    function cap(list) {
      list.forEach(function (pp) {
        var s = sim[pp.id]; if (!s) return;
        var f = [];
        if (pp.hp != null) { f.push({ k: 'HP', before: s.hp, after: pp.hp }); s.hp = pp.hp; }
        if (pp.energy != null) { f.push({ k: 'EN', before: s.en, after: pp.energy }); s.en = pp.energy; }
        if (f.length) deltas.push({ id: pp.id, fields: f });
      });
    }
    if (e.payload && e.payload.anchor) cap(e.payload.anchor.participants);
    if (e.snapshot) cap(e.snapshot.participants);
    if (deltas.length) e._delta = deltas;
  });
  P.dur = EVS[EVS.length - 1].timestamp + 500;
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   舞台：单位卡 / 状态重建 / 特效
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function buildStage() {
  var arena = $('#arena');
  arena.querySelectorAll('.unit').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); });
  var mid = arena.querySelector('.arena-mid');
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p, i) {
    var u = el('div', 'unit');
    u.id = 'unit-' + p.id;
    u.innerHTML = '<div class="u-top"><span class="u-name">' + p.name + '</span><span class="u-id">' + p.id + '</span><span class="u-dead">DEFEAT</span></div>' +
      '<div class="bar hp"><i></i><span></span></div>' +
      '<div class="bar en"><i></i></div>' +
      '<div class="u-en">EN ' + p.energy + ' / ' + p.maxEnergy + '</div>' +
      '<div class="u-buffs"></div><div class="floats"></div>';
    if (i === 0) arena.insertBefore(u, mid); else arena.appendChild(u);
  });
}
function applyListToSim(sim, list) {
  list.forEach(function (pp) {
    var s = sim[pp.id]; if (!s) return;
    if (pp.hp != null) s.hp = pp.hp;
    if (pp.energy != null) s.en = pp.energy;
    if (pp.buffs) s.buffs = pp.buffs.map(function (b) { return { name: b.name, stacks: b.stacks, turns: b.turns }; });
  });
}
function applyEventToSim(sim, ev) {
  if (ev.payload && ev.payload.anchor) applyListToSim(sim, ev.payload.anchor.participants);
  if (ev.snapshot) applyListToSim(sim, ev.snapshot.participants);
  if (ev.phase === 'buff_lifecycle' && ev.payload) {
    var p = ev.payload, s = sim[ev.targetId];
    if (s) {
      if (p.action === 'update' && p.buff) { var b = s.buffs.find(function (x) { return x.name === p.buff; }); if (b) { b.stacks = p.stacks; b.turns = p.turns; } }
      if (p.action === 'apply' && !p.resisted && !s.buffs.find(function (x) { return x.name === p.buff; })) s.buffs.push({ name: p.buff, stacks: 1, turns: p.turns || 2 });
    }
  }
}
function freshSim() {
  var sim = {};
  LOG.initialState.participants.forEach(function (p) {
    sim[p.id] = { hp: p.hp, en: p.energy, buffs: (p.buffs || []).map(function (b) { return { name: b.name, stacks: b.stacks, turns: b.turns }; }) };
  });
  return sim;
}
function paintState() {
  var turn = 0;
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) { if (ev.timestamp <= P.t && ev.phase === 'turn_flow' && ev.payload && ev.payload.action === 'start') turn = ev.payload.turn; });
  $('#turnChip').textContent = turn ? 'ROUND ' + turn : '待命';
  Object.keys(CUR).forEach(function (id) {
    var s = CUR[id], p = participant(id), u = $('#unit-' + id);
    if (!u) return;
    var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s.hp / p.maxHp * 100));
    var hpBar = u.querySelector('.bar.hp');
    hpBar.querySelector('i').style.width = pct + '%';
    hpBar.querySelector('span').textContent = Math.max(0, s.hp) + ' / ' + p.maxHp;
    hpBar.classList.toggle('warn', pct <= 50 && pct > 25);
    hpBar.classList.toggle('low', pct <= 25);
    u.querySelector('.bar.en i').style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s.en / p.maxEnergy * 100)) + '%';
    u.querySelector('.u-en').textContent = 'EN ' + s.en + ' / ' + p.maxEnergy;
    var bf = u.querySelector('.u-buffs'); bf.innerHTML = '';
    (s.buffs || []).forEach(function (b) { bf.appendChild(el('span', 'bf', b.name + (b.stacks > 1 ? ' ×' + b.stacks : ''))); });
    u.classList.toggle('dead', s.hp <= 0);
  });
  var endEv = EVS.find(function (e) { return e.phase === 'battle_lifecycle' && e.payload.action === 'battle_end'; });
  $('#stageOverlay').classList.toggle('show', !!(endEv && P.t >= endEv.timestamp));
  if (endEv) $('#ovSub').textContent = pname(LOG.winner) + ' 获胜 · ' + fmt(endEv.timestamp);
}
function rebuildState(t) {
  P.t = Math.max(0, Math.min(P.dur, t));
  CUR = freshSim();
  firedIdx = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < EVS.length; i++) { if (EVS[i].timestamp > P.t) break; applyEventToSim(CUR, EVS[i]); firedIdx = i + 1; }
  paintState();
}
function floatNum(unitId, text, cls) {
  var u = $('#unit-' + unitId); if (!u) return;
  var f = el('div', 'float-num ' + (cls || ''), text);
  f.style.left = (35 + Math.random() * 30) + '%';
  u.querySelector('.floats').appendChild(f);
  setTimeout(function () { f.remove(); }, 960);
}
var bannerTimer = null;
function setBanner(html, tone, ms) {
  var b = $('#banner');
  b.innerHTML = html; b.className = 'show b-' + tone;
  clearTimeout(bannerTimer);
  bannerTimer = setTimeout(function () { b.classList.remove('show'); }, ms || 1000);
}
function fx(ev) {
  var ph = ev.phase, pl = ev.payload || {};
  if (ph === 'battle_lifecycle') {
    if (pl.action === 'battle_start') setBanner('— BATTLE START —', 'amber', 1100);
  } else if (ph === 'turn_flow' && pl.action === 'start') {
    setBanner('— ROUND ' + pl.turn + ' —', 'slate', 850);
  } else if (ph === 'action_execution') {
    var au = $('#unit-' + ev.sourceId);
    if (au) { au.classList.add('acting'); setTimeout(function () { au.classList.remove('acting'); }, 750); }
    setBanner('⚔ ' + (pl.skill || '行动'), 'blue', 850);
  } else if (ph === 'damage_calculation') {
    if (pl.dodge) { floatNum(ev.targetId, 'DODGE', 'dodge'); }
    else {
      floatNum(ev.targetId, (pl.crit ? 'CRIT ' : '−') + pl.result, pl.crit ? 'crit' : '');
      var tu = $('#unit-' + ev.targetId);
      if (tu) { tu.classList.remove('hitfx'); void tu.offsetWidth; tu.classList.add('hitfx'); }
      if (pl.death) setTimeout(function () { floatNum(ev.targetId, 'DEFEAT', 'dodge'); }, 260);
    }
  } else if (ph === 'buff_lifecycle') {
    if (pl.resisted) floatNum(ev.targetId, '抵抗', 'resist');
    else if (pl.action === 'update') floatNum(ev.targetId, pl.buff + ' ×' + pl.stacks, 'buffup');
  } else if (ph === 'passive_trigger') {
    setBanner('⚡ 被动 · ' + pl.passive, 'cyan', 1150);
  }
}
function fire(ev) { applyEventToSim(CUR, ev); paintState(); fx(ev); }
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   播放引擎
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function updateCursorUI() {
  $('#timeRead').textContent = fmt(P.t);
  var c = $('#seekCur');
  if (c) c.style.left = (P.t / P.dur * 100) + '%';
  var last = null;
  EVS.forEach(function (e) { if (e.timestamp <= P.t) last = e; });
  $('#phaseChip').textContent = last ? (PHASE_META[last.phase].label + ' · ' + last.id) : '—';
  document.querySelectorAll('.srow').forEach(function (r) {
    var e = BYID[r.dataset.eid]; if (!e) return;
    r.classList.toggle('past', e.timestamp <= P.t);
    r.classList.toggle('cur', last && e.id === last.id);
  });
  if (P.playing && P.follow && last) {
    var row = document.querySelector('.srow[data-eid="' + last.id + '"]');
    var box = $('#streamBox');
    if (row && box) {
      var rt = row.offsetTop, rh = row.offsetHeight, st = box.scrollTop, vh = box.clientHeight;
      if (rt < st + 30 || rt + rh > st + vh - 30) box.scrollTop = rt - vh / 2;
    }
  }
}
function tickLoop(now) {
  if (!P.playing) return;
  var dt = now - P.last; P.last = now;
  P.t = Math.min(P.dur, P.t + dt * P.speed);
  while (firedIdx < EVS.length && EVS[firedIdx].timestamp <= P.t) { fire(EVS[firedIdx]); firedIdx++; }
  updateCursorUI();
  if (P.t >= P.dur) { pause(); return; }
  P.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickLoop);
}
function play() {
  if (P.t >= P.dur) rebuildState(0);
  P.playing = true; P.last = performance.now();
  $('#btnPlay').textContent = '⏸';
  P.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tickLoop);
}
function pause() {
  P.playing = false;
  $('#btnPlay').textContent = '▶';
  if (P.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(P.raf);
}
function seekTo(t, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  pause();
  rebuildState(t);
  if (opts.fireIds) opts.fireIds.forEach(function (id) { var e = BYID[id]; if (e) fx(e); });
  updateCursorUI();
  if (opts.autoplay) play();
}
function stepEvent(dir) {
  var target = null;
  if (dir > 0) target = EVS.find(function (e) { return e.timestamp > P.t + 1; });
  else { for (var i = EVS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (EVS[i].timestamp < P.t - 1) { target = EVS[i]; break; } }
  if (target) { selectEvent(target.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); }
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   事件流 / 因果树 渲染
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderStream() {
  var box = $('#streamBox'); box.innerHTML = '';
  var shown = 0;
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) {
    var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
    if (meta.debugOnly && !state.showDbg) return;
    shown++;
    var sep = ev.phase === 'turn_flow';
    var root = ev.phase === 'battle_lifecycle';
    var r = el('div', 'srow' + (sep ? ' sep' : '') + (root ? ' root' : ''));
    r.dataset.eid = ev.id;
    r.innerHTML = '<span class="s-time">' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="s-ico ' + meta.cls + '">' + meta.icon + '</span>' +
      '<span class="s-sum">' + (sep ? '◇ ' + ev.summary : ev.summary) + '</span>';
    r.addEventListener('click', function () { selectEvent(ev.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
    box.appendChild(r);
  });
  $('#evCount').textContent = shown + ' / ' + EVS.length;
}
function renderTree() {
  var box = $('#treeBox'); box.innerHTML = '';
  var roots = EVS.filter(function (e) { return !e.parentId; });
  function node(ev, depth) {
    var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
    if (meta.debugOnly && !state.showDbg) return;
    var r = el('div', 'trow');
    r.dataset.eid = ev.id;
    r.style.paddingLeft = (10 + depth * 15) + 'px';
    r.innerHTML = '<span class="t-ico ' + meta.cls + '">' + meta.icon + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t-sum">' + ev.summary + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t-corr">' + ev.correlationId.replace('corr_', '') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t-time">' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</span>';
    r.addEventListener('click', function () { selectEvent(ev.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
    box.appendChild(r);
    (CHILDREN[ev.id] || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; })
      .forEach(function (c) { node(c, depth + 1); });
  }
  roots.forEach(function (r) { node(r, 0); });
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   走带 / 刻度
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function buildSeek() {
  var seek = $('#seek');
  seek.querySelectorAll('.tick,.cur').forEach(function (n) { n.remove(); });
  EVS.forEach(function (ev) {
    var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
    if (ev.phase === 'turn_flow' && ev.payload.action === 'start') {
      var tm = el('i', 'tick tm');
      tm.style.left = (ev.timestamp / P.dur * 100) + '%';
      tm.title = 'ROUND ' + ev.payload.turn + ' · ' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + ' · 点击跳转回合';
      tm.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); seekTo(ev.timestamp, { autoplay: P.playing }); });
      seek.appendChild(tm);
    }
    var tk = el('i', 'tick ' + meta.tick);
    tk.style.left = (ev.timestamp / P.dur * 100) + '%';
    tk.title = fmt(ev.timestamp) + ' · ' + ev.summary;
    tk.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); selectEvent(ev.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
    seek.appendChild(tk);
  });
  var cur = el('b', 'cur'); cur.id = 'seekCur'; cur.style.left = '0%';
  seek.appendChild(cur);
  seek.onclick = function (e) {
    var rect = seek.getBoundingClientRect();
    seekTo((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width * P.dur);
  };
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   检视器（共用渲染器 · payload 数据驱动）
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function emptyInspector() {
  return '<div class="insp-empty-wrap"><div class="insp-empty">点击事件流、因果树或走带刻度以检视<br>回放与调试共用同一渲染数据源</div>' +
    '<div class="kbd-hints"><span><b>空格</b> 播放 / 暂停</span><span><b>←</b> / <b>→</b> 上一事件 / 下一事件</span><span><b>F</b> 跟随开关</span></div></div>';
}
function countUp(node, target) {
  var t0 = performance.now(), dur = 550;
  (function f(t) { var p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / dur); p = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
    node.textContent = Math.round(target * p); if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(f); })(t0);
}
function fmtVal(op, v) { if (op === '×') return '× ' + v; if (op === '−') return '− ' + Math.abs(v); if (op === '+') return '+ ' + v; return String(v); }
function secFormula(steps, result) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">计算过程 · PAYLOAD.STEPS</div>';
  var fbox = el('div', 'fbox ticked');
  steps.forEach(function (m) {
    var opCls = m.op === '×' ? 'mul' : (m.op === '−' ? 'sub' : 'add');
    var vCls = m.op === '×' ? 'mul' : ((m.op === '−' || m.v < 0) ? 'neg' : 'pos');
    var row = el('div', 'frow');
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="fop ' + opCls + '">' + (m.op || '＝') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="flab">' + m.n + '<span class="src">' + m.src + '</span></span>' +
      '<span class="fval ' + vCls + '">' + fmtVal(m.op, m.v) + '</span>';
    fbox.appendChild(row);
  });
  if (result != null) {
    var res = el('div', 'fres');
    res.innerHTML = '<span class="lab">FINAL · 结算结果</span><span class="num" data-v="' + result + '">0</span>';
    fbox.appendChild(res);
  }
  wrap.appendChild(fbox);
  return wrap;
}
var ROLL_NAME = { hit: '命中判定', crit: '暴击判定', resist: '效果抵抗', passive: '被动触发率' };
function secRng(rolls) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">随机判定凭证 · PAYLOAD.ROLLS</div>';
  rolls.forEach(function (c) {
    var pass = c.roll < c.rate, pct = (c.roll * 100).toFixed(1), th = (c.rate * 100).toFixed(1);
    var item = el('div', 'rng');
    item.innerHTML = '<div class="rng-top"><span class="rng-name">' + (ROLL_NAME[c.kind] || c.kind) + '</span>' +
      (c.buff ? '<span class="rng-note">· ' + c.buff + '</span>' : '') +
      '<span class="rng-idx">RNG #' + String(c.idx || 0).padStart(4, '0') + ' · xorshift32</span></div>' +
      '<div class="rng-bar"><i class="rng-fill ' + (pass ? 'pass' : 'fail') + '" data-w="' + pct + '%"></i><b class="rng-th" style="left:' + th + '%"></b></div>' +
      '<div class="rng-nums"><span>阈值 <b>' + th + '%</b></span><span>ROLL <b style="color:' + (pass ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--cyan)') + '">' + pct + '%</b></span>' +
      '<span class="rng-verdict ' + (pass ? 'v-pass' : 'v-fail') + '">' + (pass ? '判定通过' : '判定未通过') + '</span></div>';
    wrap.appendChild(item);
  });
  return wrap;
}
function secDelta(ev) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">状态变化 · SNAPSHOT</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'dbox');
  ev._delta.forEach(function (d) {
    box.appendChild(el('div', 'd-tgt', 'PARTICIPANT · <b>' + pname(d.id) + '</b>'));
    d.fields.forEach(function (f) {
      var delta = f.after - f.before;
      var p = participant(d.id);
      var pct = f.k === 'HP' ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, f.after / p.maxHp * 100)) : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, f.after / p.maxEnergy * 100));
      var row = el('div', 'drow');
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="dstat">' + f.k + '</span><span class="dbar"><i class="' + (f.k === 'HP' ? 'hp' : 'en') + '" data-w="' + pct + '%"></i></span>' +
        '<span class="dbefore">' + f.before + '</span><span class="dafter" style="color:' + (delta < 0 ? 'var(--red)' : 'var(--green)') + '">' + f.after + '</span>' +
        '<span class="ddelta ' + (delta < 0 ? 'dec' : 'inc') + '">' + (delta > 0 ? '+' : '') + delta + '</span>';
      box.appendChild(row);
    });
  });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
function secChain(nodes) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">事件因果链 · PAYLOAD.CHAIN</div>';
  nodes.forEach(function (n, i) {
    var node = el('div', 'cnode');
    node.innerHTML = '<span class="cnum">' + (i + 1) + '</span><div><div class="ct">' + n.t + '</div><div class="cd">' + n.d + '</div></div>';
    wrap.appendChild(node);
  });
  return wrap;
}
function secScores(pl) {
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">AI 候选评分 · PAYLOAD.CANDIDATES</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'dbox');
  pl.candidates.forEach(function (c) {
    var win = c.id === pl.chosen;
    var row = el('div', 'scrow' + (win ? ' win' : ''));
    row.innerHTML = '<span class="n">' + c.name + (win ? ' ✓' : '') + '</span><span class="b"><i data-w="' + c.score + '%"></i></span><span class="v">' + c.score + '</span>';
    box.appendChild(row);
  });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
var KV_LABEL = { skill: '技能', hits: '段数', controlMode: '控制模式', buff: 'Buff', resisted: '是否被抵抗', passive: '被动', chance: '触发概率', death: '致死', dot: '持续伤害', counter: '反击', reason: '重算原因', configs: '配置条数', validated: '校验通过', winner: '胜方', rounds: '总回合', action: '动作', engine: '引擎' };
function secKV(pl, skip) {
  var rows = [];
  Object.keys(pl).forEach(function (k) {
    if (skip.indexOf(k) >= 0) return;
    var v = pl[k];
    if (v === null || typeof v === 'object') return;
    rows.push([KV_LABEL[k] || k, String(v)]);
  });
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  var wrap = el('div');
  wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">载荷字段 · PAYLOAD</div>';
  var box = el('div', 'kvbox');
  rows.forEach(function (r) { box.appendChild(el('div', 'kvrow', '<span class="k">' + r[0] + '</span><span class="v">' + r[1] + '</span>')); });
  wrap.appendChild(box);
  return wrap;
}
function renderInspector(ev) {
  var box = $('#insp'); box.innerHTML = '';
  var meta = PHASE_META[ev.phase];
  var hd = el('div', 'insp-hd');
  hd.innerHTML = '<div class="insp-kicker">' + ev.id + ' · <span class="' + meta.cls + '">' + ev.phase + '</span> · ' + ev.correlationId +
    (ev.parentId ? ' · ← ' + ev.parentId : '') + ' · t=' + fmt(ev.timestamp) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="insp-title">' + ev.summary + '</div>' +
    '<div class="insp-actions"><button class="btn" id="btnPlayHere">▶ 从此播放</button><button class="btn" id="btnExpEv">⇩ 导出事件 JSON</button></div>';
  box.appendChild(hd);
  $('#btnPlayHere').addEventListener('click', function () { seekTo(ev.timestamp, { fireIds: [ev.id], autoplay: true }); });
  $('#btnExpEv').addEventListener('click', function () { download('event_' + ev.id + '.json', JSON.stringify(ev, null, 2)); toast('已导出事件 ' + ev.id); });
  var pl = ev.payload || {}, secs = [], i, s;
  if (pl.steps) secs.push(secFormula(pl.steps, pl.result));
  if (pl.rolls) secs.push(secRng(pl.rolls));
  if (ev._delta) secs.push(secDelta(ev));
  if (pl.chain) secs.push(secChain(pl.chain));
  if (pl.candidates) secs.push(secScores(pl));
  if (pl.fields) {
    var w2 = el('div');
    w2.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">属性重算 · PAYLOAD.FIELDS</div>';
    var b2 = el('div', 'kvbox');
    pl.fields.forEach(function (f) { b2.appendChild(el('div', 'kvrow', '<span class="k">' + f.k + '</span><span class="v">' + f.from + ' → <b style="color:var(--amber)">' + f.to + '</b></span>')); });
    w2.appendChild(b2); secs.push(w2);
  }
  var kv = secKV(pl, ['steps', 'rolls', 'chain', 'candidates', 'fields', 'anchor', 'result']);
  if (kv) secs.push(kv);
  var kids = CHILDREN[ev.id];
  if (kids && kids.length) {
    var w3 = el('div');
    w3.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-t">子事件 · PARENTID (' + kids.length + ')</div>';
    kids.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; }).forEach(function (c) {
      var cm = PHASE_META[c.phase];
      var r = el('div', 'childrow');
      r.innerHTML = '<span class="ci ' + cm.cls + '">' + cm.icon + '</span><span class="cs">' + c.summary + '</span><span class="ctm">' + fmt(c.timestamp) + '</span>';
      r.addEventListener('click', function () { selectEvent(c.id, { seek: true, fx: true }); });
      w3.appendChild(r);
    });
    secs.push(w3);
  }
  secs.forEach(function (s, idx) { if (s) { s.classList.add('sec'); s.style.animationDelay = (idx * 70) + 'ms'; box.appendChild(s); } });
  requestAnimationFrame(function () { requestAnimationFrame(function () {
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-w]').forEach(function (n) { n.style.width = n.dataset.w; });
    var num = box.querySelector('.fres .num');
    if (num) countUp(num, +num.dataset.v);
  }); });
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   选择 / 深链 / 导出
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function selectEvent(id, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var ev = BYID[id]; if (!ev) return;
  state.sel = id;
  document.querySelectorAll('.srow.sel,.trow.sel').forEach(function (n) { n.classList.remove('sel'); });
  var r1 = document.querySelector('.srow[data-eid="' + id + '"]'); if (r1) r1.classList.add('sel');
  var r2 = document.querySelector('.trow[data-eid="' + id + '"]'); if (r2) r2.classList.add('sel');
  renderInspector(ev);
  if (opts.seek) seekTo(ev.timestamp, { fireIds: opts.fx ? [id] : [] });
  try { history.replaceState(null, '', '#e=' + id); } catch (err) {}
}
function applyDeepLink() {
  var m = location.hash.match(/e=([\w]+)/);
  if (m && BYID[m[1]]) { selectEvent(m[1], { seek: true, fx: true }); return true; }
  return false;
}
function copyDeepLink() {
  var url = location.href, done = function () { toast('深链已复制 — 打开即定位到该事件并同步回放位置'); };
  var fb = function () { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = url; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {} ta.remove(); done(); };
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(fb); else fb();
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   状态栏 / 诊断
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function updateStatus() {
  var v = VAL;
  $('#stSchema').innerHTML = 'STREAM v' + LOG.version + ' · <span class="' + (v.errors.length ? 'st-warn' : 'st-ok') + '">' + v.errors.length + ' 错误 / ' + v.warnings.length + ' 警告</span>';
  $('#stEvents').textContent = '事件 ' + v.stats.events + ' · 因果链 ' + v.stats.chains;
  $('#stAnchors').textContent = '锚点 ' + v.stats.anchorsEv + ' 增量 + ' + v.stats.anchorsTurn + ' 全量';
  $('#stSeed').textContent = 'SEED ' + LOG.randomSeed + ' · 解析 ' + (TIMINGS.parse + TIMINGS.validate).toFixed(1) + 'ms';
  $('#cmdMeta').innerHTML = 'BATTLE <b>' + LOG.battleId + '</b><br>RECORDED <b>' + new Date(LOG.startTime).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ') + '</b>';
}
function openDiag() {
  var list = $('#diagList'); list.innerHTML = '';
  var rows = [];
  rows.push(['info', '格式', 'events[0] 含 phase + correlationId → 统一事件流，回放与调试全功能']);
  rows.push(['ok', '时基', 'battle_start 为相对零点 · performance.now() 单调时基']);
  if (VAL.errors.length) VAL.errors.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['err', '错误', x]); });
  else rows.push(['ok', '校验', '结构校验通过 — ' + VAL.stats.events + ' 事件 / ' + VAL.stats.checks + ' 次随机判定']);
  VAL.warnings.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['warn', '警告', x]); });
  VAL.infos.forEach(function (x) { rows.push(['info', '索引', x]); });
  rows.push(['info', '性能', '解析 ' + TIMINGS.parse.toFixed(1) + 'ms · 校验 ' + TIMINGS.validate.toFixed(1) + 'ms（工作线程）']);
  rows.push(['info', '裁决', '回放与调试是同一数据源的两个投影 — 无第二份事件序列']);
  rows.forEach(function (r) { list.appendChild(el('div', 'dl', '<span class="tag ' + r[0] + '">' + r[1] + '</span><span>' + r[2] + '</span>')); });
  $('#diag').classList.add('open');
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   启动
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function bootLine(html) { var i = bootLineIdx++; setTimeout(function () { $('#bootLines').appendChild(el('div', 'bl', html)); }, i * 175); }
function setBar(p) { var i = bootLineIdx; setTimeout(function () { $('#bootBar').style.width = p + '%'; }, i * 175); }
function boot() {
  var t0 = performance.now(), raw = JSON.stringify(ARCHIVE);
  bootLine('> 载入存档 ............... <span class="ok">OK</span> <span class="dim">v2.0.0 · ' + ARCHIVE.events.length + ' 事件 · ' + (raw.length / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB</span>'); setBar(14);
  runPipeline(raw, function (res) {
    LOG = res.log; VAL = res.validation; TIMINGS = res.timings;
    bootLine('> 格式检测 .............. <span class="ok">统一事件流</span> <span class="dim">phase + correlationId → 全功能</span>'); setBar(36);
    bootLine('> 时基校验 .............. <span class="' + (VAL.errors.length ? 'warn' : 'ok') + '">' + (VAL.errors.length ? '异常' : 'OK') + '</span> <span class="dim">battle_start @ 0:00.000 · 单调非降</span>'); setBar(55);
    bootLine('> 因果完整性 ............ <span class="ok">OK</span> <span class="dim">' + VAL.stats.chains + ' 条因果链 · 父引用全部解析</span>'); setBar(72);
    bootLine('> 锚点索引 .............. <span class="ok">OK</span> <span class="dim">事件级增量 ×' + VAL.stats.anchorsEv + ' + 回合级全量 ×' + VAL.stats.anchorsTurn + '</span>'); setBar(88);
    bootLine('> 就绪 · 回放与调试共享同一数据源'); setBar(100);
    buildIndices(); buildStage(); buildSeek();
    renderStream(); renderTree();
    $('#insp').innerHTML = emptyInspector();
    updateStatus();
    rebuildState(0); updateCursorUI();
    var wait = Math.max(0, 1500 - (performance.now() - t0));
    setTimeout(function () {
      $('#boot').classList.add('done');
      if (!applyDeepLink()) setTimeout(function () { play(); }, 400);
    }, bootSkip ? 0 : wait);
  });
  $('#boot').addEventListener('click', function () { bootSkip = true; if (LOG) $('#boot').classList.add('done'); });
}
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
   事件绑定
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  $('#btnPlay').addEventListener('click', function () { P.playing ? pause() : play(); this.blur(); });
  $('#btnStart').addEventListener('click', function () { seekTo(0); });
  $('#btnEnd').addEventListener('click', function () { seekTo(P.dur); });
  $('#btnPrev').addEventListener('click', function () { stepEvent(-1); });
  $('#btnNext').addEventListener('click', function () { stepEvent(1); });
  $('#btnFollow').addEventListener('click', function () { P.follow = !P.follow; this.classList.toggle('on', P.follow); toast(P.follow ? '跟随已开启 — 播放时事件流自动滚动' : '跟随已关闭'); });
  $('#speedSeg').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      P.speed = +this.dataset.s;
      $('#speedSeg').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('on'); });
      this.classList.add('on');
    });
  });
  $('#btnDbg').addEventListener('click', function () {
    state.showDbg = !state.showDbg;
    this.textContent = state.showDbg ? '调试专属 · 显示' : '调试专属 · 隐藏';
    this.classList.toggle('on', state.showDbg);
    renderStream(); renderTree();
    toast(state.showDbg ? '已显示调试专属事件（ai_decision / attribute_recalc / config_load）' : '调试专属事件已按 §5.2 分类表隐藏');
  });
  $('#btnLink').addEventListener('click', copyDeepLink);
  $('#btnExport').addEventListener('click', function () {
    download('battle_debug_' + LOG.battleId + '_v' + LOG.version + '.json', JSON.stringify(LOG, null, 2));
    toast('已导出统一存档 — 一份文件，回放与调试两种能力');
  });
  $('#stSchema').addEventListener('click', function () { $('#diag').classList.toggle('open'); openDiag(); });
  $('#btnDiagClose').addEventListener('click', function () { $('#diag').classList.remove('open'); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
    if (e.code === 'Space') { e.preventDefault(); P.playing ? pause() : play(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); stepEvent(1); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); stepEvent(-1); }
    else if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') { $('#btnFollow').click(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Escape') { $('#diag').classList.remove('open'); }
  });
  setInterval(function () {
    var d = new Date();
    $('#stClock').textContent = 'UTC ' + String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getUTCSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
  }, 1000);
  boot();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
